models.description: Phase-1 hand-tuned threshold classifier (packages/detector/src/classify.ts). Still available as the PipelineDeps default when `classify` isn't overridden.

Small MLP (10 → 32 → 16 → 4, ReLU/softmax) classifying JoltFeatures + speedMps into pothole/speed_bump/rough_road/other. Runs on-device as a pure-JS forward pass (packages/detector/src/model.ts) since native TFLite can't run in Expo Go; also exported to .tflite for when the app moves to a custom dev client.
pipeline: ml/export/export_model.py — TFLite + portable JSON weights export
ml/export/sync_to_app.mjs — JSON → TS module for the app bundle
